front.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120m-plus, reviving the franchise
front.tldr: Lionsgate's dystopian franchise opener took the third-best Friday of the six-film series and more than $120m domestically, a strong comeback after 2023's Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes underperformed.

front.title: Muru
front.tldr: Graham Dumpleton, who built mod_wsgi twenty years ago, has written Muru, a new AI-assisted Rust server for serving Python web applications in production, documented by Simon Willison.

front.title: Antonelli fastest but Verstappen takes pole for the Las Vegas Grand Prix
front.tldr: Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap in Las Vegas qualifying, but a five-place grid penalty hands pole to Max Verstappen, with George Russell starting alongside him.

stories.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts 'existential threat' of AI surveillance
stories.tldr: Signal is limiting screenshot capability in its Android and iOS apps, a defensive move against AI tools built to scrape chat screens for surveillance.

stories.title: An actor licensed his face to an AI microdrama startup, a trend already popular in China
stories.tldr: An actor has licensed his face for use in AI-generated microdramas, a practice already established in China, raising questions about what it means for Hollywood if the trend spreads.

stories.title: Alaska's next governor-elect has made more than 13,000 Wikipedia edits
stories.tldr: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, Alaska's governor-elect, has made more than 13,000 Wikipedia edits, an unusual hobby for an incoming state leader.

stories.title: iOS 27: my favorite new iPhone features, other than AI
stories.tldr: iOS 27 shipped alongside heavy Siri AI coverage, but it also brought smaller refinements elsewhere. 9to5Mac picks out a handful of the non-AI changes worth noticing.

stories.title: A week with the new privacy controls in MacOS 27.3 beta 2
stories.tldr: John Gruber finds Apple's new Full Disk Access and other privacy controls in MacOS 27.3 mostly good, though he dislikes the permanent menu bar indicator for apps that control others.

stories.title: Apple documents extra Apple Intelligence usage limits per iCloud+ paid tier
stories.tldr: From the 2027 software releases, Siri AI and Apple Intelligence stay free for supported devices, but Apple's support pages now spell out extra usage allowances tied to paid iCloud+ tiers.

stories.title: How the Elsinore makeup team transformed Andrew Scott and Olivia Colman
stories.tldr: In Elsinore, Andrew Scott plays actor Ian Charleson, who performed his final role while dying of AIDS; Variety details how the makeup team aged and transformed him and Olivia Colman for the part.

stories.title: Jeff Goldblum performs a piano medley and reflects on his career at Marrakech Film Festival
stories.tldr: Jeff Goldblum was honoured with a tribute award at the Marrakech Film Festival, playing a surprise piano medley before reflecting on more than fifty years in film.

stories.title: Russell Crowe's request to shoot A Beautiful Mind chronologically added $1 million to the budget, says Ron Howard
stories.tldr: Ron Howard says Russell Crowe's suggestion to film A Beautiful Mind in script order cost the studio an extra $1 million, but called it the right kind of investment for the performance.

stories.title: The Celtics, in all of their early-season glory, haven't passed Brad Stevens' test yet
stories.tldr: The Celtics are 11-4 a fifth of the way through the season, a strong start that CelticsBlog says still hasn't fully answered coach Brad Stevens' tougher questions about the roster.

stories.title: F1 2026 Las Vegas GP starting grid after five penalties
stories.tldr: Grid penalties reshuffled the Las Vegas Grand Prix starting order well away from Saturday's qualifying times; The Race sets out the final lineup ahead of the race.

stories.title: F1 still 'very small' in US, says Domenicali
stories.tldr: F1 chief executive Stefano Domenicali says the championship remains 'very small' in the United States, despite the sport's rapid growth there in recent years.

stories.title: Red Sox trade Johan Oviedo to Diamondbacks in exchange for minor leaguer Luke Dotson
stories.tldr: Boston has traded pitcher Johan Oviedo to the Diamondbacks for minor leaguer Luke Dotson, a year after giving up a top-100 prospect to acquire him.

stories.title: These ranked prospects got 40-man roster spots
stories.tldr: The Red Sox have protected a group of ranked prospects by adding them to the 40-man roster ahead of next month's Rule 5 draft.
